create_stats_instance: create a Stats instance to track LLM execution latency timestamps
track_model_load_time: call on_model_load_start and on_model_load_end to measure model loading duration
track_inference_timing: use on_inference_start and on_inference_end to measure total inference time
track_sampling_time: use on_sampling_begin and on_sampling_end to aggregate sampling time across tokens
export_stats_to_json: call to_json or to_json_string to export stats as a JSON dictionary or string
